The Roadmap

Fifteen modules, and they are not a list — they are a causal chain. Each module exists because the previous one hit a wall. Click a node and the first thing you get is not "what it is" but what broke to make it necessary. Every colour on this page is computed from the atom data at the top of the file, so it cannot flatter you: a node turns green only when a cold gate is logged.

▼ unfold the dependency graph — 15 modules, … atoms

The dependency graph — read it left to right

The graph is drawn from the data block, not by hand. When a /gate passes and an atom's status changes to banked, this node's colour, the counters above, and the module's completion fraction all move together. There is nowhere for it to lie.

The honest count

… atoms are enumerated here, straight from SYLLABUS.md. That is fewer than the ~250 you had in your head — and the reason is worth knowing: Modules 2–14 have not been run through /breakdown yet. They are still syllabus bullets, and a bullet reliably splits into two or three real teachable atoms once it is decomposed. Expect the true figure to land somewhere around 200–300. The number will go UP as the map gets more honest, not as you learn more — do not read that as progress.
